declarations.explanation: `.factory/Dockerfile` installs only Hemiciclo's toolchain on a Debian-based image: `FROM node:24-bookworm`, which provides the Node.js 24 the development guide requires. Git and the GitHub CLI, the guide's other prerequisites, come from the factory's agent layer under the sandbox image contract, so the file installs neither. It creates no user, sets no ENTRYPOINT or CMD, uses no COPY or ADD, and installs no project dependencies. Hemiciclo has no application code, so no other runtime, compiler or package manager is required yet. This repository never had a `.sandcastle/Dockerfile`, so there were no earlier toolchain lines to carry over. Docker was not available to this session, so the build is proven by the pull request's `Sandbox image` job.

node:24-bookworm is Debian bookworm with apt-get, matching the contract's base requirement; its existing `node` user is allowed by the contract.
The repository has no package manifest, so there is nothing for a run to install beyond the toolchain.
